"""Identifier case conversion."""

from __future__ import annotations


def snake_case(text: str) -> str:
    """Convert an identifier or phrase to ``snake_case``.

    Spaces, hyphens and underscores separate words, and so does a change
    from a lowercase letter or a digit to an uppercase one
    (``helloWorld`` -> ``hello_world``, ``version2Update`` ->
    ``version2_update``). A run of consecutive uppercase letters belongs to
    one word: an uppercase letter only starts a new word when it follows
    a lowercase letter or a digit, or when it follows another uppercase
    letter and is itself followed by a lowercase letter (in that case it is
    the first letter of the next word). Thus ``HTTPServer`` becomes
    ``http_server`` and ``XMLHttpRequest`` becomes ``xml_http_request``.

    The result is lowercase, never contains two underscores in a row, and
    never starts or ends with one.

    Args:
        text: Input identifier, e.g. ``camelCase``, ``PascalCase`` or
            ``kebab-case``.

    Returns:
        The ``snake_case`` form of ``text``.
    """
    words: list[str] = []
    current: list[str] = []

    for index, char in enumerate(text):
        if char in " -_":
            if current:
                words.append("".join(current))
                current = []
            continue

        if char.isupper():
            starts_new_word = False
            if current:
                prev = text[index - 1]
                if prev.islower() or prev.isdigit():
                    starts_new_word = True
                elif prev.isupper() and index + 1 < len(text) and text[index + 1].islower():
                    starts_new_word = True
            if starts_new_word:
                words.append("".join(current))
                current = []

        current.append(char.lower())

    if current:
        words.append("".join(current))

    return "_".join(words)

from textkit.case import snake_case
cases = {
    "HTTPServer": "http_server",
    "XMLHttpRequest": "xml_http_request",
    "userID": "user_id",
    "helloWorld": "hello_world",
    "HelloWorld": "hello_world",
    "hello big-world": "hello_big_world",
    "already_snake_case": "already_snake_case",
    "version2": "version2",
    "version2Update": "version2_update",
    "  __hello  world__ ": "hello_world",
}
for src, exp in cases.items():
    got = snake_case(src)
    status = "OK " if got == exp else "FAIL"
    print(f"{status} {src!r} -> {got!r} (expected {exp!r})")
assert all(snake_case(k) == v for k, v in cases.items())
# no double/leading/trailing underscores for a batch
extra = ["HTTP", "ABC", "ABc", "ABCdef", "HTTPServerHTTP", "A", "", "___", " -_ "]
for s in extra:
    r = snake_case(s)
    assert "__" not in r and not r.startswith("_") and not r.endswith("_"), (s, r)
print("all extra checks passed")
EOF
